verdict.rationale: Aircall's own marketing describes built-in AI Assistants that automatically capture notes, update CRM records, create follow-up tasks, and give real-time guidance, so a native assistant does take work off the user. The evidence shows only fixed automations, not tasks a user hands off on request, and it is homepage marketing only. Missing for 10: user-initiated or ad-hoc task delegation to the assistant, in-depth first-party docs on assistant capabilities, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
